newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-SHEARER COULD RETURN FOR CHELSEA MATCH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SHEARER COULD RETURN FOR CHELSEA MATCH.

text.p: Newcastle manager Kevin Keegan is confident that Alan Shearer will make his comeback for the English premier league leaders in Saturday's clash at Chelsea.

Though he has said Shearer would not be involved in Tuesday night's UEFA Cup third round first leg tie against Metz, not even as a substitute, Keegan said his star striker is on course to return to first team action at Stamford Bridge - exactly one month after his groin operation.
"Saturday is very much a date to be pencilled in for him unless anything goes wrong between now and then," Keegan said on Tuesday.
